offerings.cycle_label: Summer Day Camp youth volunteers - verified 2026-09-08
offerings.summary: Teens aged fifteen and over help run Prince George's County summer day camps for twelve to fifteen hours a week after completing pre-service training in the spring.

loc.venue: Summer day camp sites across Prince George's County

age.raw: Youth volunteers must be the required age on or before May 31 to volunteer: ... Summer Day Camps: 15 years old

other: Individuals ages 15 and older must complete a criminal background history check
All youth volunteers must attend pre-service training in May/June
Youth Individuals cannot volunteer at a site where a younger sibling or child is a registered participant
Individuals can sign up to volunteer at only one Summer Playtime or Summer Day Camp

sched.hours_raw: Volunteers are scheduled 12-15 hours per week

app.instructions: Apply online during the spring window, then attend pre-service training in May or June.

opens.raw: Volunteer applications are accepted online from March 1-May 1

deadlines.raw: Volunteer applications are accepted online from March 1-May 1

issues: The March 1 to May 1 window is published without a year.
The page does not say whether these youth roles carry a stipend.
